notes: Static flake smells in test code. A match is a lead, never a flake: it becomes a flake only when runs show a pass and a fail. Patterns are line regexes applied to test files of the listed languages; 'cause' is the cause class the smell usually leads to, and 'fix' the usual remedy. Comment lines are skipped. Optional per smell: 'skip_if_prev' / 'skip_if_next' (regexes for the previous / next non-blank line that make a hit a false lead, e.g. a locator argument inside a multi-line `await expect(`), 'mitigated_by' (a regex; when the file or a test setup file matches, the hit is kept with a 'mitigation' note) and 'mitigation' (that note). Scope 'thread_setup' is a project check: the pattern is looked for only in Vitest/Jest setup files, and only when Vitest runs tests in worker threads.

smells.message: Fixed sleep in a test
smells.fix: Wait on the condition with a deadline (an Event, thread.join(timeout), or a polling helper), not on time.

smells.message: Fixed delay in a test (test.setTimeout / jest.setTimeout set a time limit and are not matched)
smells.fix: Use the framework's waiting assertions (expect.poll, toPass, findBy*, waitFor) on the state you need.

smells.message: Fixed sleep in a test
smells.fix: Use Awaitility, CountDownLatch.await(timeout) or Espresso idling resources.

smells.message: Fixed sleep in a test
smells.fix: Synchronise on a channel or sync.WaitGroup with a timeout.

smells.message: Fixed sleep in a test
smells.fix: Wait on the condition with a deadline (poll with a timeout, recv_timeout on a channel, or a Condvar), not on a fixed sleep.

smells.message: Wall-clock or monotonic-clock read in a test
smells.fix: Inject a clock or a fixed timestamp; freeze time rather than reading the real clock, or compare durations with a tolerance.

smells.message: Randomness in a test
smells.fix: Seed the RNG deterministically (SeedableRng::seed_from_u64) and record the seed, or assert on properties instead of exact values.
smells.mitigation: a seeded RNG is used (check this test draws from the seeded RNG, not a thread-local one)

smells.message: Fixed network port bound or connected in a test
smells.fix: Bind to port 0 and read back the port the OS assigned.

smells.message: Fixed temporary path shared between tests
smells.fix: Use a unique directory per test (tempfile::tempdir / TempDir); if the path is only an argument passed to the program under test, note that and dismiss the smell.

smells.message: Process-global environment or working directory changed in a test (cargo runs tests in parallel threads of one process, so this leaks across tests)
smells.fix: Avoid mutating process-global state: pass env and cwd explicitly, or serialise these tests (a shared lock, or --test-threads=1) and restore what you changed.

smells.message: Module-level mutable static
smells.fix: Avoid static mut; use a per-test instance or reset it in setup, so tests don't depend on order.

smells.message: Local wall-clock read in a test
smells.fix: Freeze the clock (the repo's clock helper, freezegun or time-machine) or compare in UTC on both sides.

smells.message: Wall-clock read in a test
smells.fix: Use fake timers (vi.useFakeTimers, jest.useFakeTimers) with setSystemTime, or inject a clock.
smells.mitigation: fake timers or a fixed system time are used (the read may see the fake clock; check it is active for this test)

smells.message: Wall-clock read in a test
smells.fix: Inject a java.time.Clock and use Clock.fixed in tests.

smells.message: Unseeded randomness in a test
smells.fix: Seed it (random.Random(seed), Faker.seed) and record the seed, or assert on properties instead of values.

smells.message: Unseeded randomness in a test
smells.fix: Seed faker (faker.seed) or stub Math.random.
smells.mitigation: Math.random is stubbed or faker is seeded (check the stub is active for this test)

smells.message: Assertion on the order of a set
smells.fix: Compare sets, or sort both sides.

smells.message: Module-level mutable state
smells.fix: Reset it in a fixture (autouse) or inject it, so tests don't depend on order.

smells.message: Fixed network port bound or listened on (a URL string naming a port is not matched)
smells.fix: Bind port 0 and read the port the OS assigned.

smells.message: HTTP call whose URL is not a literal loopback address (a variable URL counts: it may reach an outside host)
smells.fix: Stub the HTTP client (responses, respx, pytest-httpserver) or record and replay; if the URL is a local test server, note that and dismiss the smell.

smells.message: Fixed temporary path shared between tests
smells.fix: Use the tmp_path fixture or tempfile.mkdtemp per test.

smells.message: Playwright call without await
smells.fix: await the call; enable @typescript-eslint/no-floating-promises.

smells.message: Module-level let reassigned inside a test: later tests in the file see the value it left
smells.fix: Reset it in beforeEach (or restore it in afterEach / a finally in the same test), or make it a const created per test.

smells.message: process.env.TZ assigned in a test setup file that runs in worker threads, where it does not change the time zone
smells.fix: Set TZ before the workers start: in the test script (TZ=... vitest), or at the top of vitest.config.* (it runs in the main process); or use pool: 'forks'. Then delete the ineffective assignment.

smells.message: Module reloaded in a test: what the module read at import (environment, settings) stays changed for every later test, and later tests can come to depend on it
smells.fix: Undo it in the same test or fixture: restore the environment and reload the module again in a finalizer (a yield fixture after monkeypatch), or make the module read the setting when called instead of at import.

smells.message: Setting read from the environment at import, in a module a test reloads: the reload changes it for every later test
smells.fix: Read the variable when the function runs (or through a settings object a fixture can override), so tests need no reload.
